findings.description: Therapy Stores, a gift-shop chain, filed in May for the conditional-use authorization the city requires to open a formula-retail outpost at 32 Clement Street, after buying the building in December 2025 for nearly $2 million and opening without the required permit; the planning commission was to vote on the application on 24 September. Neighborhood merchants oppose it. Nothing for the building block: the article is about a tenant's permit fight, not the structure.

citation.label: Mission Local, “Tchotchke shop chain draws ire of Clement Street merchants,” 24 September 2026

raw.text: Chen bought the 32 Clement St. building in December 2025 for nearly $2 million and registered her business there that month.

EAS puts 32, 34 CLEMENT ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 32.
